**General**
- Don't install libfmt system-wide when compiling on linux (thanks @jjbarr)

**Game Formats & Features Support**
- Added missing ZDoom special 107 (thanks @quotepilgrim)
- Fixed casing on HUD-related ACS functions (thanks @DoomKrawa)

**Scripting**

**Map Editor**
- When opening a map in the map editor, it's entries are now locked so that changes can't be made to them outside the map editor (and potentially overwritten)

- Fixed crash when applying sector properties
- Fixed invalid sector references when copy/pasting sectors in certain situations
